messages.subject: Payroll instruction — Whitford settlement
messages.plaintextBody: Please process the following for D. Whitford, to reach him within 14 days of 26 Feb: (1) PILON of £245,000 through payroll (tax + NI); (2) ex gratia £185,000, first £30,000 tax-free, balance taxed; (3) accrued holiday £4,712 (taxed). Separately pay Harland Vesey LLP £750 + VAT on their invoice addressed to Mr Whitford. Reference WC-00198. Miriam
